## Lab 08

```{python}
import polars as pl
basics = pl.read_csv("title.basics0.tsv.gz", separator="\t", null_values=r"\N")
ratings = pl.read_csv("title.ratings.tsv.gz", separator="\t", null_values=r"\N")
principals = pl.read_csv("title.principals0.tsv.gz", separator="\t", null_values=r"\N")
```

1.  Quais são os 5 filmes com as maiores notas (averageRating)? Apresente uma solução capaz de desempatar os filmes baseando-se no número de votos recebidos.

```{python}
q1 = (
    basics
    .filter(pl.col("titleType") == "movie")
    .join(ratings, on="tconst", how="inner")
    .sort(by=["averageRating", "numVotes"], descending=[True, True])
    .select(["tconst", "primaryTitle", "averageRating", "numVotes"])
    .head(5)
)

print(q1)
```

2.  Qual é o gênero mais frequente entre os filmes com nota maior que 8?

```{python}
q2 = (
    basics
    .filter(pl.col("titleType") == "movie")
    .join(ratings, on="tconst", how="inner")
    .filter(pl.col("averageRating") > 8)
    .filter(pl.col("genres").is_not_null())
    .with_columns(pl.col("genres").str.split(","))
    .explode("genres")
    .with_columns(pl.col("genres").str.strip_chars())
    .group_by("genres")
    .len()
    .sort(by="len", descending=True)
    .head(1)
)

print(q2)
```

3.  

```{python}
q3 = (
    basics
    .filter(pl.col("titleType") == "movie")
    .join(ratings, on="tconst", how="inner")
    .filter(pl.col("averageRating") > 7.5)
    .join(principals, on="tconst", how="inner")
    .filter(pl.col("category").is_in(["actor", "actress"]))
    .group_by("nconst")
    .len()
    .sort(by="len", descending=True)
    .head(3)
)

print(q3)
```
